title: German Apple Strudel
description: A classic German dessert made with apples, sugar, and pastry. Perfect for a sweet treat.
instructions: Unroll the strudel dough and cut into 3 equal pieces.
Mix together the sugar, cinnamon, and vanilla extract.
Add the sliced apples to the sugar mixture and toss to coat.
Place a piece of dough on a flat surface and brush with melted butter.
Place a third of the apple mixture onto the dough, leaving a 1-inch border.
Roll the dough into a tight log and place seam-side down on a baking sheet.
Repeat with the remaining dough and apple mixture.
Brush the tops of the strudels with melted butter and sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
